title: Product surface audit — scanning page, UI breakage, design language, QOL, capability drift
summary: First audit in this repo to cover the user-facing surface. Ten prior audits all scoped auth/ssrf/crypto/idor/scanner; none scoped UI, design, mobile, or UX. Covers the scanning page latency and rebuild, client-visible breakage, responsive breakage on 71 pages, design-language conformance across every surface, quality-of-life restructuring including the bulk-action inventory, and backend/frontend capability drift across 155 API routes plus schema, config, flags and permissions.
